payload.title: Story cycle: make --refresh-packets and --max-parallel-* real, validate packets, make apply_records idempotent
payload.description:
src/papyrus_newsroom/coverage_theme.py:757 declares refresh_packets but the only uses write it into relation metadata (:4196, :4249, :4333, :4403); no 'if refresh_packets' exists, and apply_records (:5355) upserts the deterministic packet id, so applied reruns always re-run agents and overwrite packets, contradicting AGENTS.md and skills/newsroom-story-cycle/SKILL.md. papyrus_newsroom/cli.py:467-468 accept --max-parallel-research and --max-parallel-reporting that nothing reads. coverage_theme.py:4493-4515 fills missing packet keys with defaults (editor_recommendation -> 'hold', copywriter_brief -> '', lists -> [], degraded forced False), so an agent returning {} passes --require-agent-success. apply_records (:5333-5367) creates Message, two ModelAttachments and a SemanticRelation sequentially and raises on first failure, leaving partial packets, and the warnings list is never returned. list_references_by_corpus and list_references_by_newsroom_feed_imported (reference_curation_signals.py:2706,2719) silently stop at 1000 rows.

Fix: check _record_exists('Message', story_cycle_packet_message_id(assignment, kind)) before dispatch and skip unless refresh_packets; implement bounded ThreadPoolExecutor dispatch for the parallel flags or remove them and the skill text; raise when any skill-required packet key is absent; make apply_records resume idempotently in dependency order and return the failure list; paginate to exhaustion or return truncated: true. Add unit tests under procedures/newsroom/tests for each.

Done when: a second applied run with existing packets makes zero agent calls unless --refresh-packets is passed, and an empty packet fails --require-agent-success.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
